prompt: What number comes next in this sequence: 1, 11, 21, 1211, 111221, ...?
explanation: Each term describes the digits of the one before, read in runs: 111221 is 'three 1s, two 2s, one 1', which is written 312211. The same reading turns 1 into 11, 11 into 21, and so on through the sequence.
